prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: square game map tile, readable at 16px and 24px
Primary request: one simple mountain peak viewed from an elevated map angle, broad soft painted shape, clearly volumetric rather than a side-on silhouette
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with no background color, no checkerboard, no border
Subject: a single broad gray mountain peak centered in the canvas, with one small ivory snow cap and a broad darker shadow plane; feathered foothill edges fade softly into transparency
Style/medium: soft hand-painted game atlas illustration, clean readable shapes, restrained detail
Composition/framing: square canvas, one centered mountain only, generous transparent margins, elevated oblique overhead angle so the top and slopes are visible
Lighting/mood: gentle diffuse light, soft painted shading
Color palette: cool medium gray rock, darker gray shadow plane, small warm ivory snow cap
Materials/textures: broad smooth brushwork, subtle paper-like painted texture, no hard outlines
Constraints: output must preserve real RGBA transparency around the mountain; only one mountain; optimized to remain legible when downscaled to 16px and 24px
Avoid: side-on triangular silhouette, multiple peaks, trees, buildings, clouds, sun, text, symbols, black or white background, checkerboard preview baked into pixels, frame, border, photorealism, sharp vector geometry, excessive detail
